scope: Fifteen complete guarded original format/keyframe/interpolation bodies; all rows/outcomes and full original machine/RAM state. Independent exact dyadic linear/Catmull-Rom results, sampled transform arguments and record/counter advances.
limitations: Format mesh handler uses supplied original motion-mesh target as an explicit -2 boundary. Alternate record handlers use original native empty callback as supplied callback data, proving control flow rather than morph output.
Legacy native remainder/copy/state/matrix services retain valid-RAM and bounded ABI support. Shared vector numerical reference is qualified separately; exact dyadic curve checks are independent.
No physical GPU pixels, natural scene/player initialization, full draw/frame/gameplay, high-FPS or playable-port proof.
